name: NOAA Great Lakes Fish Habitat Restoration Partnership Grants
summary: US federal grants, paid from the Great Lakes Restoration Initiative, for habitat restoration that brings lasting benefits to native Great Lakes fish, such as coastal wetland and river habitat work in the eight US Great Lakes states.

geography.label: Great Lakes basin in the eight US Great Lakes states

calls.label: Applications for federal fiscal year 2027

status.quote: This funding opportunity will remain open until 2026, contingent on the availability of funds.

deadline.quote: To be considered for funding in the 2027 federal fiscal year, applications are due by September 4, 2026.

calls.note: The last deadline of the current funding opportunity, which stays open until 2026 if funds allow.

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants are institutions of higher education, non-profit organizations, commercial (for profit) organizations, U.S. territories, and state, local and Native American tribal governments.

geography.quote: must propose work within the Great Lakes basin and within one of the eight U.S. Great Lakes states (New York, Pennsylvania, Ohio, Michigan, Indiana, Illinois, Wisconsin, and Minnesota)

access.quote: Applicants should apply through the www.Grants.gov website.

window.quote: Applications will be accepted and considered on an annual basis as they are received each year.
